High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7155 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohd Junaid

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
Home Deptt. Civil Sectt Lko Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Madhavan,R.B.S. Rathaur
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Aklavya,Sarjoo Ram Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the informant was married to a person, however he had given divorce to her and subsequently the applicant on the false pretext of marriage formed physical relations with the victim and subsequently he refused to marry.

The statement under Section 161 &
164 Cr.P.C. was given to the same effect.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 31.03.2023.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

sentences.text:
4. Considering that admittedly the victim is aged about 28 years and physical relations in between the applicant and the victim continued over a span of two years allegedly on the ground of false pretext of marriage in view law as explained in the case of Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana,
AIR 2013 SC 2071

entities.text:
Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana,
AIR 2013 SC 2071
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 31.03.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Mohd. Junaid be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 149 of 2023, under Sections 376, 313, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Pratapgarh, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Arun  Mohd Junaid vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...
